    Ro = p.box_od/2
    Ri = Ro - p.box_wall
    base = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).extrude(p.base_t)
    wall = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).circle(Ri).extrude(p.box_depth)
    box = base.union(wall)

    # disk bosses (full-height columns) at +-hr
    hr = p.disk_holes_c_c/2
    bd = p.m3_head_d + 6
    boss = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(bd/2).extrude(p.box_depth)
    pilot = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_pilot_d/2).extrude(p.screw_depth)
    for x in (-hr, hr):
        box = box.union(boss.translate((x,0,p.base_t)))
        box = box.cut(pilot.translate((x,0,p.box_depth - p.screw_depth)))

    # perf standoffs
    sd = p.perf_corner_hole_d + 4.5
    ix = p.perf_corner_hole_inset
    px = [-p.perf_l/2+ix, p.perf_l/2-ix]
    py = [-p.perf_w/2+ix, p.perf_w/2-ix]
    stall = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(sd/2).extrude(p.perf_standoff_h)
    spilot = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_pilot_d/2).extrude(p.perf_standoff_h)
    for sx in px:
        for sy in py:
            box = box.union(stall.translate((sx,sy,p.base_t)))
            box = box.cut(spilot.translate((sx,sy,p.base_t)))

    # USB slot in +x wall
    slot = cq.Workplane('XZ').rect(p.usbc_w, p.usbc_h).extrude(4*p.box_wall)
    box = box.cut(slot.translate((Ro, 0, p.usbc_z)))

    # keyholes in base (hang)
    kings = cq.Workplane('XY')
    for (kx,ky) in p.keyhole_pos:
        hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.hang_screw_head/2).extrude(p.base_t+1)
        s = cq.Workplane('XY').rect(p.hang_slot_w, p.hang_slot_h).extrude(p.base_t+1)
        box = box.cut(hole.translate((kx,ky,0)))
        box = box.cut(s.translate((kx, ky + p.hang_slot_h/2, 0)))
    return box
